01 / THE ENVIRONMENT

Not another tool call.
A place to do the work.

Agents need more than a prompt.
Give them the same primitives
you use to build.

▤

A filesystem that stays.

Keep dependencies, intermediate results, and hard-won context in one workspace.

/workspace → persistent
⌁

Room to experiment.

Install packages, run scripts, and use a browser inside an isolated environment.

agent → isolated VM
⤴

A clean starting point.

Snapshot an environment. Fork it for the next task. Pick up without starting over.

snapshot → fork → continue
02 / FROM PROMPT TO PROCESS

Set the boundary.
Let it work.

Provision a machine, hand it to your agent,
and keep control of its lifecycle.

See the example ↗
01

Create

Start with a clean environment or a saved snapshot.

02

Connect

Give your agent access to the shell, files, and browser.

03

Continue

Keep useful state. Pause or remove the machine when done.

03 / A SMALL API. A WHOLE COMPUTER.

Less plumbing.
More possibility.

A proposed SDK interface for Field.
Adaptable to the agent loop you already have.

example.py ILLUSTRATIVE API
from field import VM

vm = VM.create("research-agent")

# Give your agent a place to work
vm.run("python research.py")

# Keep what it learned
vm.snapshot("research-complete")
